audit.whatIsWrong: Two places state that Ragnarok 'deals true damage through your shields'. Ragnarok does no true damage at all.
audit.why: Riot's text for Ragnarok: passive armour and magic resist, active immunity to disables while he keeps attacking. The true damage in Olaf's kit is Reckless Swing (E) — 325 range, 11/10/9/8/7s, and it costs Olaf health unless it kills.
audit.corrected: Ragnarok = disable immunity plus resists; Reckless Swing = the true damage, and baiting it costs him his own HP.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6, First item and 2+ items were scored Lucian/Skill/Lucian while whys[4], whys[5] and whys[6] on the same rows say his ult ignores your kite, his lifesteal out-heals your poke, and you can no longer kite or out-trade him.
audit.why: 37.5% win rate and the packet chart gives Olaf every stage from Levels 4-5 onward. The prose already agreed; only the tokens disagreed.
audit.corrected: phases[3..6].side and win[3..6] -> Olaf, proposed as matched pairs.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[3..6].why were the generic Lucian boilerplate and named none of Olaf's spikes.
audit.why: The real curve is Berserker Rage sustain from level 4, Ragnarok at 6 (100/90/80s), a lifesteal component at first item, and bruiser stats at two.
audit.corrected: Each stage now names the Olaf spike that owns it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every 'count Undertow' line lacked the number, and none explained why standing on the axe matters.
audit.why: Undertow is a flat 9s at all ranks, but picking the axe up resets the cooldown outright — denying the pickup is what converts the dodge into a real window.
audit.corrected: Flat 9s, reset on pickup, stand on the axe.

audit.whatIsWrong: The kit's derived flags mark Undertow with 'grounding' (shuts off enemy dashes). Riot's own description says only that it reduces Armor and Move Speed.
audit.why: Per the calibration rule, the description outranks a derived flag. If Undertow really denied Relentless Pursuit, every dodge instruction on this page would be wrong — so it must not be asserted either way.
audit.corrected: Nothing written. Flagged for a human check.

edits.before: Keep the pressure rolling but track Undertow (Axe) — your lead is HP-bar bullying, not all-in math, until items arrive.
edits.after: Berserker Rage gives more attack speed and lifesteal the lower he gets, so long trades now heal him and only hurt you.

edits.before: The Culling adds lane-clear and execute chip — use it through walls on recalls and low-HP escapes.
edits.after: Ragnarok's disable immunity and resists beat your kite — never fire The Culling into an active Ragnarok.

edits.before: First item spike is your kill window — the dash-weave combo now deletes half bars. Force the issue before he stabilizes.
edits.after: His first lifesteal item heals through your Q chip faster than you chip him — stop trading, farm at max range.

edits.before: You fall off relative to top-lane scalers — convert the lead into towers and roams before the 3-item brawlers arrive.
edits.after: A 2-item Olaf runs you down: Undertow slows, Reckless Swing's true damage ignores armour, and you cannot kite it.

edits.before: Ragnarok makes him CC-immune and deals true damage through your shields, so his all-in ignores your kite entirely.
edits.after: Ragnarok makes him immune to disables and adds resists, while Reckless Swing's true damage ignores everything you buy.

edits.before: Olaf's Ragnarok (R) makes him CC-immune and deals true damage through shields, so his all-in ignores everything you have.
edits.after: Olaf's Ragnarok (R) makes him immune to disables and grants resists; the true damage is Reckless Swing (E), up every 7-11s.

edits.before: Axe slows let him reach you — stand on the pickup spot to deny resets. Until it’s spent, every commit is a coin flip.
edits.after: Undertow is a flat 9s unless he picks the axe back up — stand on it to deny the reset, then take your window.

edits.before: Olaf whiffs Undertow (Axe) and the lane briefly belongs to you.
edits.after: Reckless Swing costs him health — bait it and his own bar drops.

edits.before: That is Olaf’s rehearsed moment — don’t audition for it.
edits.after: His lifesteal scales with missing health — never extend.

notes: The 'Ragnarok deals true damage' error was in two layers and would have taught a paying user to buy armour against the wrong ability. Reckless Swing is the true-damage button and it self-damages, which is a real bait. Also unresolved: the kit's derived grounding flag on Undertow contradicts Riot's description — see audit point 13. diff still reads EVEN at 5.5/10 with the chart now four-fifths Olaf; that rating and breakdown.difficulty/report[14] should probably move together, but that is three linked strings plus an enum and I left it as a deliberate call.
